steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Brace Yourself!
steps.body:
Oof — that stings! Monsters are fast. Combat is turn-based and the fastest units act first, based on their Speed stat. Most creatures have higher Speed than your heroes, so expect to take a hit before you can swing back.

Keep an eye on the turn order — it tells you who's coming next.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Your Heroes' Abilities
steps.body:
Each hero has two abilities — a primary attack they use often, and a special skill on a longer cooldown. When both are recharging, they fall back to a basic attack.

Pick an action each turn: Basic Attack, Ability A, or Ability B. Or hit Auto to let them fight on their own.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: After the Fight
steps.body:
After victory, loot drops from defeated enemies. You'll route each piece into your hero bags or shopkeeper bag before moving on.

Speed gear and buffs can help your heroes act before monsters in later fights — worth investing in!
